details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1013,1043,1052,1097,1105,1122 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `marker` output is written in every exit path of the inject-bait step but no downstream step reads `steps.inject-bait.outputs.marker`.
  WHY: Dead GitHub step output serializes an unused value on every run and can mislead maintainers into thinking Phase 4b depends on it.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1696-1704 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: API failure is handled by `PR_HEAD=$(gh api ... || echo "")`, which can produce an empty `PR_HEAD` and let the commit check pass falsely.
  WHY: On transient GitHub API failure, the gate can report success without actually verifying the PR head commit.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1618-1620 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The retry selection uses `tail -n 1`, which picks the oldest matching workflow run instead of the newest.
  WHY: GitHub workflow runs are returned newest-first, so selecting the oldest run can misclassify retry status.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1527-1534 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `PYTEST_AVAILABLE=false` is set after install failure, but `run_pytest` still invokes `python3 -m pytest` unconditionally.
  WHY: If pytest is unavailable, the step can crash in a way that is misclassified as a spec mismatch instead of an infrastructure failure.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:355-361 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The `REVIEW_WORKFLOW_FILE` validation regex has a problematic character class range.
  WHY: The pattern can be parsed unpredictably across regex engines/locales, risking incorrect acceptance or rejection of workflow filenames.
- tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:45-56 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `_load_expected_content` does not validate `E2E_EXPECTED_RUN_ID` before ASCII encoding/substitution.
  WHY: A malformed run ID can raise a cryptic encoding or byte-mismatch failure instead of a clearer validation error.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:764-766 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The shell logic references `$REVIEW`, but that variable is never defined or assigned.
  WHY: An undefined shell variable makes `REVIEW_OK` evaluate false, which can produce incorrect aggregator behavior.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1104,1107,1114,1222 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Comments in the Bug B fallback section reference `internal-review.yml` literally even though the runtime uses `${REVIEW_WORKFLOW_FILE}`.
  WHY: The comments are stale and can mislead maintainers when a consumer repo renames the workflow file.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1740,1742 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The retry dispatch comment block says it redispatches `internal-review.yml`, but the code dispatches `${REVIEW_WORKFLOW_FILE}`.
  WHY: The comments are stale and can mislead maintainers debugging renamed wrapper workflows.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1768-1782 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `classify_pytest_failure` relies on an implicit `else` branch rather than an explicit `^ERROR ` check.
  WHY: The current fallback is correct, but the classification boundary is less explicit and could drift silently if pytest output changes.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1013,1045,1097,1104,1105,1122 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The inject-bait step writes `marker=${BAIT_MARKER}` to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` in all exit paths even though the output is unused.
  WHY: This is dead output that adds noise without affecting runtime behavior.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:355-361 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The `REVIEW_WORKFLOW_FILE` filename validation regex is considered invalid because of the character class range.
  WHY: A malformed regex could cause workflow filename validation to behave unpredictably.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1060 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The bait marker line starts with `# `, but the grep used by `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh` is claimed not to match it.
  WHY: If the grep missed the bait marker, the smoke override would never trigger and the Phase 4b gate would always fail.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:763-766 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The aggregator’s `REVIEW_OK` logic is driven by an undefined `$REVIEW` shell variable.
  WHY: An empty `$REVIEW` causes the status check to always evaluate false, which can produce incorrect skip/continue behavior.
- tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:937-960 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `_load_expected_content(run_id: str)` calls `run_id.encode("ascii")` without validating the input format.
  WHY: A malformed `E2E_EXPECTED_RUN_ID` can raise `UnicodeEncodeError`, surfacing as a test failure rather than a clearer misconfiguration.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
